title: 'Varanasi': SS Rajamouli reveals Mahesh Babu and Priyanka Chopra's globe-trotting epic spans from Antarctica to ancient Rome
description: Director SS Rajamouli is building anticipation for his upcoming film 'Varanasi'. The epic journey will span locations from Varanasi to Antarctica and ancient Rome. Filming is nearly eighty percent complete, with major action sequences already wrapped. Production and post-production are progressing simultaneously, integrating VFX seamlessly. 'Varanasi' is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on April 7, 2027.
